pr_body:
Fixes #30575

Adds a new property 'UnsafePreferInlineScheduling' to HttpSysOptions that when true, executes request on the IO callback thread instead of queuing the request to the thread pool.

issue_context.title: Add new HttpSysOptions to bypass UnsafeQueueUserWorkItem call and process requests on IO thread
issue_context.body:
As part of the SharePoint team's migration to .NET Core, we are building a router based on http.sys queue delegation to enable migrating APIs over time. Since this router is adding latency to every request it's critical we add as little as possible. 

Currently [MessagePump.ProcessRequestsWorker()](https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/blob/20b6779cf3af2fed6a8fe64a0865cfab50b776bb/src/Servers/HttpSys/src/MessagePump.cs#L179) calls ThreadPool.UnsafeQueueUserWorkItem to queue the RequestContext to a thread pool thread for processing. This is done to quickly free up the MessagePump thread to start accepting new requests. 

We'd like to add a new option in HttpSysOptions to bypass this call and directly process the request on the IO thread and then accept a new request afterwards. This should be acceptable in our scenario since request processing is very quick.

Based a prototype and some benchmarking, with the current Http.sys server implementation, we can process requests in 300 microseconds at P95. We found that ~118 microseconds come from the delay added by queueing the request to another thread. Without this call we were able to processes requests in 190 microseconds at P95.
